digest.component_or_area: Jira DC hardening / reconciler capability detection and inbound probe subsystem
propositions: Post-run Epic-field contract validation in jira_dc_capability_map.py must refuse to vouch for reports it cannot verify and exit non-zero with verdict in run_metadata.json rather than silently writing wrong contracts.

Capability call sites must be runtime-guarded with isinstance-primary and hasattr-fallback pattern to handle __getattr__-proxying transports on Python 3.12+, with distinct outbound-<capability>-capability-absent reporting to bridge_alerts instead of silent failures.
The dormant inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, classify_probe_response, probe_remote implementations, and related probe.py modules) must be deleted from the codebase.
Orphaned configuration keys jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses left without readers by port deletion require deprecation or removal handling.
The live DC harness must not regress due to these three changes; pre-existing failures from commit c87afedba8 are tracked separately on ticket 9590-34f5-21a8-41fc.
No test cells must be deleted, skipped, or xfail-marked to achieve harness green; only the pre-existing xfail owned by ticket 2b16 is permitted.
